name: Blanks
tagline: Fill in the blank. The worst answer wins.
description: A black card sets up the sentence; everyone plays the white card from their hand that finishes it best (or worst). The TV reads every combination out one at a time, then the room votes — or a rotating judge picks. One point per round won. Three decks from family-safe to fully explicit; the VIP chooses.

settings.label: Decks
settings.description: Which cards are in play: Mild is safe for anyone, Crude is R-rated, WILD is fully explicit

settings.label: Who picks the winner
settings.description: Everyone votes on the cards, or one player judges each round in turn

settings.label: Rounds
settings.description: Black cards to play; about a minute each in a small room, closer to two with a full one

settings.label: Cards dealt
settings.description: White cards in each hand; a new hand swaps them all

settings.label: Timed rounds
settings.description: Put a clock on picking, voting and the result; off = play at your own pace, anyone taps Next

settings.label: Answer time (timed rounds)
settings.description: Seconds to pick a card when rounds are timed; Pick 2 and Pick 3 cards get 15 s more each

settings.label: Rando
settings.description: A random card from the deck plays every round as a phantom player; if it wins, nobody scores
